about_the_game:
Do Your Job

You’re part of the Containment Crew—the night shift maintenance team keeping the facility running when everyone else has gone home. Replace fuses, fix leaks, patch walls, and make sure the lights stay on… even when something wants them off.

Contain the Anomalies

Every shift brings new problems. Some can be solved with duct tape. Others require running very fast in the opposite direction. Keep the anomalies contained, keep your cool, and whatever you do—don’t open the wrong door.

Upgrade Your Gear

Use your shift pay to upgrade your office, unlock better tools, and improve your defenses. Stronger doors, longer-lasting lights, smarter scanners—anything to give you an edge before the next breach hits.

Survive with Friends

Bring your coworkers along for the ride. Coordinate repairs, divide the workload, and try not to panic when the alarms start blaring. Teamwork keeps the power on—and keeps you alive.

Welcome to the Night Shift

You’re not here to be a hero. You’re here to keep the systems online, get the job done, and clock out in one piece. But down here, maintenance isn’t just about fixing what’s broken… it’s about surviving what breaks free.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: As part of the Containment Crew, it’s your job to keep the facility running—clean spills, replace fuses, and keep the power on. But when containment breaches occur, every shift becomes a fight to finish your duties and make it through the night alive.
